method_name: Ablação de M5: híbrido BM25 + Nemotron 3.5 Embed 1B (encoder 8x menor)
advantage_hypothesis: custo menor de embedding mantendo o ganho do híbrido
code_note: fusion functions re-implemented from the paper (RRF; min-max convex); ranx cited as reference implementation
implementation: bm25s lucene (M1 frozen) + exact cosine over NVIDIA embeddings
deviation_from_reference: Fusion tuned on 30 dev queries; dense scoring exact (no ANN); Nemotron embedder replaces the paper's encoders.

usage.note: corpus/query vectors from the free NVIDIA endpoint; tuning reused stored query vectors, the timed passes call the API for every query
